scientific_integrity: The all-parameter classification has an analytic matrix and cyclic Green-function proof. A standard-library exact-arithmetic script checks finite examples only and is not used as proof. The closest 2015 heat-equation full text could not be retrieved; the limitation is disclosed. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Uniform periodic one-dimensional \(P_1\) finite elements with consistent mass matrix only; nonuniform meshes, Dirichlet boundaries, higher dimensions, mass lumping, and other time integrators are not classified.
title: Exact positivity threshold for consistent-mass backward Euler on a periodic linear finite-element mesh
